extension.description: Record and play guided tours of codebases directly in VS Code.
configuration.title: CodeTour
configuration.promptForWorkspaceTours: Show a notification when a workspace containing tours is opened for the first time.
configuration.showMarkers: Show tour markers in the editor gutter.
configuration.customTourDirectory: Custom workspace-relative directory used to discover tours.
configuration.autoUpdateAnchors: Automatically update symbol and content anchors when monitored source edits can be tracked safely.
view.title: CodeTour
view.welcome:
Record a guided walkthrough for the current workspace ([Learn More](https://github.com/ElluIFX/better-codetour#recording-tours)).

[Record Tour](command:codetour.recordTour)

You can also open a tour shared by someone else.

[Open Tour File](command:codetour.openTourFile)

[Open Tour URL](command:codetour.openTourUrl)
